topic: 动词时态与被动语态综合全能突破 (Mastery of Verb Tenses and Passive Voice)
teaching_notes:
1. 【核心概念】：把时态想象成‘时间胶囊+动作摄像机’！‘时间胶囊’决定动作发生的时刻（过去、现在、将来），‘动作摄像机’决定动作的状态（一般、进行、完成）。而‘被动语态’则是把摄像机镜头对准了‘动作的承受者’（被……）。
2. 【语法公式与口诀】：
- 主动语态黄金公式：主语 + 动词时态变化 + 宾语
- 被动语态万能公式：主语 + be + 动词过去分词 (V-ed) + (by 动作实施者)
- 记忆口诀：‘被动 be 动不能少，过去分词紧跟跑；时态全在 be 上变，主谓一致看前端！’
3. 【中小学生易错点】：
- 陷阱一：单三漏写 -s/-es（如：He play football ❌ -> He plays football ✔️）。
- 陷阱二：被动语态漏掉 be 动词（如：The book written by me ❌ -> The book was written by me ✔️）。
- 陷阱三：状语从句忘记‘主将从现’原则（如：If it will rain tomorrow... ❌ -> If it rains tomorrow... ✔️）。
4. 【经典例句】：
- 小学基础：Look! Tim is playing basketball on the playground.（看！蒂姆正在操场上打篮球。）
- 初中进阶：By the time we arrived at the cinema, the movie had already started.（当我们到达电影院时，电影已经开始了。）
- 高中压轴：The groundbreaking paper was being written by the scientist when the power cut occurred.（当断电发生时，那位科学家正在撰写那篇突破性的论文。）

questions.question: Tom _____ his bicycle every Sunday morning.
questions.explanation: 考查一般现在时。时间状语 every Sunday morning 表经常性习惯，主语 Tom 为第三人称单数，谓语动词 wash 应变为 washes。

questions.question: Look! The children _____ kites in the park.
questions.explanation: 考查现在进行时。提示词 'Look!' 表明动作正在进行，结构为 be + V-ing，主语 The children 是复数，故选 are flying。

questions.question: My mother _____ a delicious cake for my birthday yesterday.
questions.explanation: 考查一般过去时。时间状语 yesterday 表示过去发生的事，make 的过去式为不规则变化 made。

questions.question: We _____ the Shanghai Science and Technology Museum next Saturday.
questions.explanation: 考查一般将来时。时间状语 next Saturday 表示将来的动作，用 will + 动词原形。

questions.question: Lucy usually _____ up at 6:30 in the morning.
questions.explanation: 考查频度副词与一般现在时。频度副词 usually 表习惯，主语 Lucy 是第三人称单数，故用 gets。

questions.question: Listen! Someone _____ the piano in the music room.
questions.explanation: 考查现在进行时。提示词 'Listen!' 表明听到此时此刻正在发生的动作，Someone 看作单数，用 is playing。

questions.question: I have already _____ my homework, so I can watch TV now.
questions.explanation: 考查现在完成时。结构为 have/has + 过去分词（V-ed），finish 的过去分词是 finished。

questions.question: They _____ to the zoo last weekend because it rained heavily.
questions.explanation: 考查一般过去时的否定句。时间状语 last weekend 表过去，一般过去时的否定借助于助动词 didn't，后接动词原形 go。

questions.question: English _____ by millions of people all over the world.
questions.explanation: 考查一般现在时的被动语态。英语是被人们说的，主语 English 为不可数名词，用 is + 过去分词 spoken。

questions.question: _____ you _____ your art teacher in the hallway two hours ago?
questions.explanation: 考查一般过去时的疑问句。借助助动词 Did，置于句首，后面的实义动词要还原为原形 see。

questions.question: Look at those dark clouds! It _____ rain soon.
questions.explanation: 考查 be going to 表示基于眼前的迹象对将来进行预测（看那些乌云，马上要下雨了）。

questions.question: This sweet birthday cake _____ by my elder sister yesterday.
questions.explanation: 考查一般过去时的被动语态。根据 yesterday 可知是过去发生的被动动作，主语 cake 单数，用 was made。

questions.question: The Browns _____ for Beijing by train tomorrow morning.
questions.explanation: 考查现在进行时表将来。位移动词如 leave, go, come 等可以用现在进行时表示按计划即将发生的动作。

questions.question: Mr. Li has taught in our primary school _____ 2015.
questions.explanation: 考查现在完成时的介词搭配。since 后接具体的时间点（如 2015），表示“自……以来”，与现在完成时连用。

questions.question: He usually walks to school, but today he _____ a bicycle.
questions.explanation: 考查习惯性动作与临时性动作对比。usually 用一般现在时，but today 表暂时的特殊动作，用现在进行时 is riding。

questions.question: By the end of last year, the engineering team _____ the bridge across the river.
questions.explanation: 考查过去完成时。标志性短语 'By the end of + 过去时间' 表示“截至到过去某时已经完成”，用过去完成时 had completed。

questions.question: I will give you a call as soon as I _____ at the airport tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 考查时间状语从句的“主将从现”原则。在 as soon as 引导的时间状语从句中，用一般现在时表示将来。

questions.question: While Mary was doing her homework, her younger brother _____ computer games.
questions.explanation: 考查过去进行时。while 引导的从句与主句动作在过去某一时间内同时发生并持续进行，主句也用过去进行时 was playing。

questions.question: He looked exhausted because he _____ in the laboratory all night.
questions.explanation: 考查过去完成进行时。描述在过去某个时刻（looked exhausted）之前一直在持续进行的动作并对当时产生影响，用 had been working。

questions.question: A new modern gymnasium _____ in our school by the end of next month.
questions.explanation: 考查将来时态的被动语态。主语 gymnasium（体育馆）是动作承受者，配合时间状语 next month，结构为 will be + 过去分词 (built)。

questions.question: Mobile phones must not _____ during the formal examination.
questions.explanation: 考查含情态动词的被动语态。结构为：情态动词 (must not) + be + 过去分词 (used)。

questions.question: When I stepped into the classroom, the blackboard _____ by the monitor.
questions.explanation: 考查过去进行时的被动语态。表示过去某一具体时刻（当我走进教室时）黑板正在被擦，结构为 was/were + being + 过去分词。

questions.question: Great achievements _____ in space exploration over the past few decades.
questions.explanation: 考查现在完成时的被动语态。标志词 'over the past few decades'（在过去几十年间）配合现在完成时，成就（achievements）是被取得的，用 have been achieved。

questions.question: If it _____ tomorrow, we will have to postpone the outdoor sports meet.
questions.explanation: 考查条件状语从句的主将从现。在 if 引导的真实条件句中，从句用一般现在时 rains 替代将来时。

questions.question: The manager announced that the meeting _____ until next Friday.
questions.explanation: 考查过去将来时的被动语态。主句 announced 为过去时，宾语从句中动作发生在主句之后（未来），且“会议是被推迟的”，用 would be postponed。

questions.question: The urgent report needs _____ to the principal before 5:00 PM today.
questions.explanation: 考查 need 表示“需要被处理”时的两种结构：need to be done 或 need doing。因此 to be handed in 和 handing in 均符合语法规则。

questions.question: Don't phone me between 8:00 and 10:00 tomorrow morning; I _____ an important exam.
questions.explanation: 考查将来进行时。表示在将来某一确切的时间段内（明天上午8:00-10:00）正在进行的动作，用 will be taking。

questions.question: I wish I _____ harder when I was at senior high school.
questions.explanation: 考查 wish 引导的虚拟语气。是对过去事实（when I was at senior high school）的遗憾与假设，谓语动词需向前推一个时态，用 had worked。

questions.question: It is reported that a breakthrough in renewable energy _____ by scientists recently.
questions.explanation: 考查形式主语句型及现在完成时被动语态。从句中近期发生的动作（recently）对现在产生影响，突破（breakthrough）是被做出的，用 has been made。

questions.question: The damaged highway _____ right now, so drivers are advised to take an alternative route.
questions.explanation: 考查现在进行时的被动语态。时间副词 'right now' 表明此时此刻正在发生，且公路是被修复的，用 is being repaired。
